title: Bumble in Talks to Go Private With Sequoia Partner Gupta’s New Venture
text:
Dating app company Bumble is in advanced talks to be taken private by a holding company founded recently by former Sequoia’s partner Ravi Gupta, the Wall Street Journal reported Monday.
A deal would value Bumble at roughly $1 billion, a steep premium to its last market cap of around $300 million ...
